CONTAINER-ONLY slice: tabs/1 renders <div id={@id} class="pa-tabs {...modifiers} {class}" ...> with a required `inner_block` slot (supplied via the `body` slot feature). keen folds border-top into its `style` enum (style="border-top"); the oracle models it as the `borderTop` bool, so keen uses a `const` that sets style="border-top" when the flag is on (card `stat` precedent). wrap-labels is the is_wrap_labels bool. scrollable is declared for axis-2 completeness; keen's scrollable SSR shell wraps the slot in __scroll-container + __scroll-btn arrows (divergent from svelte's flat shell), so it has no strict shared scenario. Per-item/panel/layout-wrapper structure (tab_item/tab_panel/tabs_content/tabs_container/tabs_vertical_layout) is the DEFERRED sub-slice — not mapped here.
